svg.text: One input coefficient, two different normal scales
Airy regions: ζ = b − t; K = 8
Orange: 0 < t < b. Green: both estimates apply.
Unit normal mass at every scale
GE11–GE13: exact cutoff boundaries. GE36: integrate each normal column before taking a frequency supremum.
The right panel illustrates the estimate mechanism; these exponential curves are not Airy solutions.
